en.headline: HSBC third-quarter pretax profit rises 32 per cent to US$9.6 billion
en.dek: The result matched analyst expectations. The bank also announced a further share buy-back of up to US$1 billion and a third interim dividend of 10 US cents.
body: HSBC reported a 32 per cent increase in third-quarter pretax profit to US$9.6 billion on Tuesday, in line with the average estimate of about US$9.7 billion compiled by the bank.

Profit rose from US$7.3 billion a year earlier. The bank said the increase reflected higher banking net interest income, lower expected credit losses and the non-recurrence of US$1.4 billion in legal provisions recorded in the same period last year. Revenue increased to US$18.6 billion.

HSBC also approved a third interim dividend of 10 US cents per share and said it would initiate a share buy-back of up to US$1 billion, expected to be completed before full-year results. Chief executive Georges Elhedery said clients continued to turn to the bank amid uncertainty.

zh.headline: 滙豐第三季除稅前利潤增32%至96億美元
zh.dek: 業績大致符合市場預期，銀行宣布最多10億美元股份回購及每股0.1美元第三次中期息。
body: 滙豐控股周二公布，2026年第三季除稅前利潤按年增加32%至96億美元，大致符合銀行彙編的分析師平均預期約97億美元。
利潤較去年同期的73億美元上升。銀行表示增幅主要來自銀行業務淨利息收益增長、預期信貸損失減少，以及去年同期14億美元法律準備不復再現。收入增至186億美元。
滙豐亦通過派發第三次中期息每股0.1美元，並擬啟動最多10億美元股份回購，預計於全年業績公布前完成。行政總裁艾橋智表示，在充滿不確定性的環境中，客戶繼續選擇與銀行合作。
